Are you looking for a side job that you can combine with your studies or family life? Then we have a great opportunity for you! For our warehouse in Ede, we are looking for a part-time order picker for both the morning and evening shifts. These shifts alternate weekly. In this role, you ensure that all orders are prepared correctly, completely, and on time for shipment.

As an order picker, you start by collecting orders in the warehouse. Using a scanner and headset, you gather the correct products while carefully checking quantities and items.

Are all products complete? Then you ensure careful and safe packaging. You select the right packaging materials, label the order correctly, and perform a final check before it is shipped.

You will work in a two-shift system: a morning shift from 07:00 to 16:00 and an evening shift from 16:00 to 00:00, alternating weekly. This means you work the early shift one week and the late shift the next.

Additionally, you are willing to work one Saturday per month from 08:00 to 16:00.

- Flexible, including one Saturday every four weeks
- Physically capable of active work
- A team player who speaks Dutch or English
- Experience as an order picker is a plus, but not required

You must be a resident of the Netherlands to apply for this position.
